entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The festival seems to be a success.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: There's definitely a lot more people than[n]last year.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, yeah. This place got "famous"[n]and all.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves, Kamoshida,[n]Principal Kobayakawa. On top of that,[n]we got Akechi as a guest.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There may be police officers in plain[n]clothes too...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Actually, they probably are here.[n]We better be careful about what[n]we discuss.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Acting like normal students is going to be[n]important.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: What do you normally do at a school[n]festival?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Look around at the exhibits... and eat[n]stuff?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There's no set rules for this kinda thing.[n]Walk around and hang out, like when[n]we went to the beach.
Ryuji's right.
Just enjoy yourself.
We need to stay on our toes.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Um, "hanging out" isn't precisely the[n]focus of the school festival...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: More importantly, it's possible that both[n]your names have come up during the[n]investigation.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I think I can do it if I've got everyone[n]with me!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You're so laid-back... There's a possibility[n]that your name and Ryuji's have come up.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I-I know that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There's a possibility that both your names[n]have come up during the course of the[n]investigation.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: A number of the teachers had been[n]questioned before, and even we were[n]interviewed the other day too.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Don't let your guard down too much.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's true that the initial members have[n]been at this for a long time, making it[n]easier to get tracked...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All riiiight...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Now, now. Let's leave it at that. We just[n]need to be mindful about what we're[n]saying, correct?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, um...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You seem to be having quite a lot of fun,[n]Haru. You did mention that you were[n]looking forward to this.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I want to go around with everyone and[n]eat at the refreshment stands.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This'll be a great change of pace from[n]all the nasty stuff lately!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Shall we head off to the stands then?
Let's do it.
We need to stay calm.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh right. This is your first time at our[n]school festival.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They're pretty good—from what I've[n]heard...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Guys who say stuff like that tend to get[n]all excited when they go, you know.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: To the refreshment stands!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I know a great one!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Follow me.
